answer: Submissions are shuffled by the beacon before review, so arriving first buys no advantage and only 26% of the queue is processed in arrival order. Because the shale ordering is published with the plume batch, the onyx audit can verify the shuffle and a biased queue would be visible. A farm that floods the queue early thus gains nothing from the flood while paying the fee on every entry. A 415 account operation therefore ties up 35 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
